text:
Maya (Sales): Short ask  Prospect Zebra Labs wants a hosted-API POC. Estimate ~20M tokens over 8 weeks, heavy first month. They asked for $0.00085/token for the POC and prefer invoice net-30. Can Deal Desk approve a temporary override?

Ravi (Deal Desk): Need legal entity and signer, model scope (all models or specific), and whether they want custom terms. Also need expected conversion to paid and whether they'll accept a min monthly floor.

Maya (Sales): Legal: Zebra Labs LLC, signer: CTO Jonah Park. Scope: gpt-open-1 only. They will accept a $4k/month floor for the 2 months if we can do the token rate. Expect ~50% convert. No custom indemnities.

Tariq (Solutions): Engineering note: can accommodate burst but recommend spike cap and API key allowlist. Suggest 12M cap month1 and enable prefix caching to reduce spend.

Lena (Security): Hosted POC OK with standard 30d logs and encryption. They'll need DPA signed. SIEM/forwarding not available for POC.

Hannah (Finance): Math: 20M @0.00085 = $17,000; standard would be $30,000 at 0.0015. With $4k/mo floor = $8k. Margin at 0.00085 likely low (~30%). Finance needs this flagged as promotional and RevOps must tag the quote.

Ravi (Deal Desk): Proposed terms: temp rate "ZEBRA-POC-60D" limited to account id and gpt-open-1, per-token $0.00085, min monthly $4k, validity 60 days then auto-revert. Add spike cap 12M month1. If agreed I'll create quote and route to Legal.

quote-bot: Quote ZEBRA-1763724450 created: https://redwood.example/quotes/ZEBRA-1763724450 (temp rate card + spike cap attached).

Maya (Sales): I'll send DPA + stub quote to Jonah today. They asked that any extension is re-priced.

Tariq (Solutions): Ops needs the allowlist and reserve window: `reserve-window: 48h before spike`, `api-key: zebra-poc`.

Lena (Security): Approve subject to DPA. If they request >30d retention well require addendum.

Hannah (Finance): Approve contingent on RevOps tag and margin note on the quote.

Ravi (Deal Desk): Logging internal precedent: token overrides < $0.001 require Deal Desk + Finance approval and min $4k floor. I'll attach margin calc and send to Legal.

Maya (Sales): Thanks everyone. Moving to Legal and will post signed quote here when returned. :thumbsup:
